🌟 DracoLure | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To act as a deceptive security honeypot that lures and analyzes malicious network traffic, identifying and blocking threats in real-time.
✨ Key Features: • Polyglot deception honeypot • Real-time detection and threat scoring • Automated quarantine and blocking of hostile sources • Serves believable bait (fake corporate portal, /.env, wp-login, etc.) • URL-decode normalization for payload analysis
📖 Summary: DracoLure is a polyglot deception honeypot designed to lure, detect, score, and quarantine malicious attackers in real-time. It serves believable bait to keep attackers engaged while analyzing their probes against a signature library, assigning threat scores, and automatically blocking hostile sources.
